name: chart
title: Chart
description: Manga-styled wrapper around the shadcn Chart (recharts). Series are told apart by screentone and hatching, never by colour: chartFill(series) gives each series a pattern (solid ink, 45° hatching, dots, horizontal lines, cross hatching, fine dots), bars and areas are outlined in 2px ink, pie slices are separated by paper gaps. Lines differ by dash and by marker (ChartMarker: square, diamond, dot). The container is a case; the tooltip is a speech bubble with a tail; the legend shows pattern swatches. Exports ChartContainer, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent, ChartLegend, ChartLegendContent, ChartStyle, ChartPatterns, ChartMarker, chartFill, chartPattern, chartPatternFill and type ChartConfig. Ink and paper only, dark mode is the negative.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/chart". It wraps your own components/ui/chart. ChartContainer renders the pattern set itself, so chartFill(...) works in any chart inside it. Set the height with the CSS variable --chart-h (default 16rem), e.g. className="[--chart-h:8rem]".

meta.tagline: Recharts in screentone: each series gets its own pattern, never a colour.
meta.usage:
import { BarChart, Bar, XAxis } from "recharts"
import { ChartContainer, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent, ChartLegend, ChartLegendContent, chartFill, type ChartConfig } from "@/components/ui/manga/chart"

const config = { reads: { label: "Reads" }, sales: { label: "Sales" } } satisfies ChartConfig
const keys = Object.keys(config)

<ChartContainer config={config}>
  <BarChart data={data}>
    <XAxis dataKey="month" />
    <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
    <ChartLegend content={<ChartLegendContent config={config} />} />
    <Bar dataKey="reads" fill={chartFill("reads", keys)} stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} />
    <Bar dataKey="sales" fill={chartFill("sales", keys)} stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} />
  </BarChart>
</ChartContainer>

props.name: ChartContainer
props.description: A case around the recharts container. className goes on the case; --chart-h sets the height.

props.name: chartFill(series, keys?)
props.description: The url(#…) fill of a series: by index, or by its config key in keys. The first series is solid ink.

props.name: chartPattern / chartPatternFill
props.description: The pattern name of a series, or the fill of a named pattern (solid, paper, hatch, cross, dots, dots-fine, lines).

props.name: ChartMarker
props.description: Point marker for a line's dot prop: a paper shape with an ink outline.

props.name: ChartTooltipContent
props.description: Speech bubble with a tail; the indicator is hidden by default (set hideIndicator={false} to show it).

props.name: ChartLegendContent
props.description: Legend with a pattern swatch per series; labels come from the config.
